5-year-old Angelica Nero shares a very special, heartfelt cover of Michael Bublé’s "Mother" as a tribute to the unconditional love of moms everywhere. This song is a gift from our hearts to yours. We hope it brings a smile (and maybe a happy tear) to your day!

🎤 Song: Mother by Michael Bublé @michaelbuble 
🌟 Performed by: Angelica Nero

snippet.title: Subnautica 2 Early Access Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Subnautica 2 is an underwater survival adventure game set on an all-new alien world. It is the next chapter in the Subnautica universe, developed by Unknown Worlds.

Driven from your home by ongoing conflict, Alterra offers you the chance at a new life. But as the colony ship CICADA shepherds you and your fellow Pioneers to your new home, something goes awry. The ship’s AI insists that your mission should continue. Stranded and faced with near-insurmountable odds, you must do everything in your power to survive. The future of humanity on this world is in your hands.

Subnautica 2 enters Early Access on May 14th, 2026, at 08:00 PDT / 15:00 UTC.

snippet.title: ROCKY 7: 2027 Final Round | Sylvester Stallone, Mike Tyson, Arnold Schwarzenegger | Concept Trailer
snippet.description:
#Rocky7 #SylvesterStallone #concepttrailer 

Witness the ultimate clash of boxing legends in this thrilling Rocky 7 fan concept trailer.

Imagine a What If scenario where the Italian Stallion returns to the ring for one final round against the most formidable opponents imaginable. I personally created the storyboard and visuals for this project to bring together Sylvester Stallone, Mike Tyson, and Arnold Schwarzenegger in an epic boxing spectacle. Fans of the beloved franchise will appreciate the hyper realistic aesthetic and vibrant training sequences that capture the raw intensity of a true heavyweight championship fight. Seeing these iconic powerhouses face off in brilliant detail brings a fresh energy to the legendary sports drama genre.

This fan made edit explores the ultimate test of legacy as Rocky Balboa prepares for the biggest fight of his life without the moody shadows of the past. By focusing on bright daylight environments and photorealistic camera work, my goal was to showcase every powerful punch with high budget clarity. The unbelievable presence of Mike Tyson and Arnold Schwarzenegger elevates the stakes to unprecedented heights for this final comeback story. Please drop your thoughts in the comments and let me know who you think would conquer this epic cinematic showdown.

Disclaimer: This video is a fan made concept trailer created purely for entertainment purposes. The storyboard and visuals were created entirely by me, and this project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to any official studio or production.

snippet.title: SEN vs NRG - VCT Americas Stage 1 - Week 5 Day 3
snippet.description:
VCT Americas Stage 1 marks the next step in the race to Champions Shanghai, and the stakes could not be higher. Twelve teams, two groups, and only three spots on the line.

Group Alpha is fueled by one central clash. Brazil versus the Americas. LOUD, MIBR led by Aspas, and FURIA bring regional pride, while Leviatán and Cloud9 look to challenge them. G2 stands in the middle, ready to prove they still belong among the elite.Group Omega is shaped by pressure. NRG stand as the favorites, but KRÜ arrive ready to fight, and Envy reenters the spotlight with legendary names looking to prove they can still compete.

Only 3 teams will reach Masters London. Tune in to find out Americas representatives!

We’re proud to work with our fantastic partners throughout 2026: ExpressVPN, HP, Pulsar, Red Bull, Samsung, Secretlab, and Verizon.

snippet.title: LCS Spring W6 | LYON vs TLAW
snippet.description:
The 2026 LCS Spring Split features a best-of-three round-robin regular season, ensuring more games, deeper rivalries, and a clear competitive arc from Week 1 to Finals. At the end of the regular season, the top six teams advance to a double-elimination playoff bracket that mirrors the Lock-In structure. Every series matters, and every adjustment counts. The stakes are high, as the top two teams qualify for the Mid-Season Invitational in Daejeon, South Korea to represent the LCS against the world’s best.

In 2026, the LCS Fantasy app becomes a comprehensive hub for fans. Schedules, standings, content, and fantasy integration all live in one place, making it easier than ever to follow the league and compete with your friends. We’re building this as a true home for LCS fans everywhere, whether you’re tuning in every weekend or tracking every stat between matches. Let us know what you think!

Catch the LCS every Saturday and Sunday (and some Fridays!):
Games begin at 1PM PT / 3PM CT / 4PM ET

League of Legends Championship Series teams include Cloud9 Kia, FlyQuest, Team Liquid Alienware, Dignitas, Shopify Rebellion, LYON, Sentinels, and Disguised.
